content: Jacob Harán-neggweburgi gudiid
Jacob dulemar-dad-nakwedsik-bukmaladse nade gusbalid.
Sapurba-nadapidgi dia sii dakalid. Ar sibad-wawaadmar a-dii gobdamarsoggu, a-dikarba sibad-wawaadmar-danapaa obunnobukwa dakdapid. Dia-birgindi, akwa-dummad siid.
Bela sibad-wawaadmar danar ase ambikunonikile, sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad akwa-dummad onir damalad, adi, diigi sibad-wawaad-ogobmalagar. Geb a-sorbali, gannar akwa-dummad dia-birgi sidamalad.
Jacob sibad-wawaad-edarbemaladse egichided: —¿An-aimar, bemar biarmaladi? Abin-imaksamalad: —Anmar Harán-neggweburginedi.
Jacob amarga sogdebalid: —¿Bemar, Nacor-e-machi-Labán-mag-dake? Abin-imakdemalad: —Eye, anmar mag dake.
Jacob ese egisdebalid: —¿Labánʼde nued gudii? Sibad-wawaad-edarbemalad abin-imakdemalad: —Eye, Labán nued gudii. Be dakena, e-sisgwa-Raquel e-sibad-wawaadmar sedanikid.

Geb degine, Jacob sogded: —Sibad-wawaad e-urbilegedgi-urbelegegala amba dad-dikasulid. ¿Ar ibiga bemar geg sibad-wawaadmarga dii ukmala? Geb sorbali, bemar sibad-wawaadmar-gagan-mamalaga gannar sedmaloed.

Ar sibad-wawaad-edarbemaladdi abin-sogdemalad: —Geg anmar deyob imakmalad. Anmar gusgu bela sibad-wawaadmar-danar-ambikued edarbedamalad. Adi, anmar akwa-dummad-dia-edisiid oniregar. Geb anmar sibad-wawaadmar diigi ogobmaloed.
Jacob, dulemar-ebo sunmakgwisgua, Raquel e-bab-sibad-wawaadmar senonikid. Ar Raquel e-babga sibad-wawaadmar-edarbedga gudiid.

Raquelʼde, Labán-e-sisgwad. Labánʼdi, Rebeca-e-susud. Jacob, e-gilor-Labán-sisgwa Labán-sibad-wawaadmar-sedani-daksagu, dia-birgi akwa-dummad-siid-onirega nade gusad. Geb onirisgua, sibad-wawaadmarga dii uksad.
Geb degine, Jacob Raquel-wagar-udapid, ega sogega, be nued sogeye. Geb degine, Jacob binnasur boded.
Jacob Raquelʼga sogdesun, ede Rebeca-machiye. Labánʼdi e-gilorye. Geb Raquel deyob itosgu, e-babga-sogega abarmakde gusad.

Labán itoargu, e-bun-Raquel-machi-Jacobʼgi ega sunmake, agi Labán abarmakded, Jacob-abin-daknaegar. Modapgu, Jacob e-nigasoggu, ise-angaagwar Jacob-imakdapid, ei-wagar usbalid, ega sogega, be nued sogeye. Geb agine, e-negse Jacob-sesad. Geb degine, Jacob bela e-gusad-igar Labánʼga sogsad.
Labán Jacobʼga sogded: “Ar be nue anbo ablis-mesadid.” Jacob Labán-walik nii-walagwen gudii gualid.
Jacob, Raquel-nikuega arbasad
Niigwen-gusad-sorbali, Labán Jacobʼga sokalid: —Be an-gwenad-inigwele, binsa geg be anga arbaed. Anga be soge, igi-mani be-bennukbi be an-abege.
Dakargu, Labán sisgan-warbo-nikad: Dummad, Leaʼye nugad. Bipigwaddi, Raquelʼye nugad.
Lea e-ibya mommoo dakleged. Raquelʼdi bela-bela yeer dakleged.
Ar Jacob Raquel-abearsoggu, Labán-abin sogded: —Be-sisgwa-bipigwad-Raquel an nikuegala, an bega birgagugle (7) arbaoed.
Geb degine, Labán Jacob-abin sogded: —Ar an-sisgwa dule-baidga-ukedba bur an bega uked nabirid. Degisoggu, be an-walik beedo.
Ar weyob Jacob Raquel-nikuegala birgagugle (7) arbasad. Ar Jacob nue-Raquel-abesoggu, dogdar birga-suitii itossulid.
Birgaguglegus (7) Jacob arbaedgine, Labánʼga sokalid: —Ar an bega sogsadyob Raquel-nikuega bato birgaguglegus (7) an bega arbadanisoggu, anga be Raquel-udage.
Geb degi, Labán e-neg-dikarba-neg-baidsik-mamaidse gochad, adi, e-sisgwa-sui-nikued-ibase dagmalagar.
A-mutiki, Labánʼdi e-sisgwa-Lea-sesad, Jacobʼga ukdapid. Jacobʼdi Raquelʼye biensoggu, aga Leaʼse gochasunnad.
Aginbali, Labán e-sisgwa-Leaʼga e-mai-wargwen uksad, adi, Leaʼga ibmar-imakegar. A-mai, Zilpaʼye nugad.
Neg-oibosgu, Jacob dakalid, Lea e-dikarba mai. Degisoggu, Jacob Labánʼga sokalid: —¿Igi be an-imaksa? Be angi dodo-soge. ¿Ar ande Raquelʼbina an bega arbassursi? ¿Ibiga degite be an-yardake?
Labán Jacob-abin sogded: —Wegine, anmarga-igar-maisulid, urba e-ior-idu sui-nikuoye.
Degisoggu, igar-maidba Lea bebogwa itoged-irgwen gudii guodo. Geb a-sorbali, an bega Raquel-ukbaloed, ar be soger, Raquelʼbina birgagugle (7) an bega arbabaloye.
Jacob sogsado, eyeye, ede arbaoye. Lea-nikusad-itoged-irgwenad-bergusgu, Labán Jacobʼga Raquel-uksabalid, adi, Jacob Raquel-nikuegar.
Labán e-mai-wargwen Raquelʼga uksamogad, adi, Raquelʼga ibmar-imakegar. A-mai, Bilhaʼye nugad.
Jacob Raquelʼse gochad. Jacob, Leaʼba-bur bule Raquelʼbina sogsasoggu, degidbali, amba birgagugle (7) Labánʼga arbadii gusbalid.
Jacob-e-masmala
Bab-Jehová dakdegu, Jacob bur Lea-baisur-dake, Lea mimmi-nikuega imaksad, Raquelʼdi geg mimmi-bake imaksad.
Lea bonigwar gunonikid. Bab-Jehová-machigwa-ega-uksadi, Rubénʼye onugsasad, ar ade, soged: “Bab-Jehová wile-itodiid an-daksad. Ar emigindi, an-sui an-sabguoed.”
A-sorbali, Lea machigwa-baid-nikunonibalid. Adi, Simeónʼye onugsasad. Geb agi sogded: “Bab-Jehová an-sui-baisur-an-daked daksad. A-ular, Bab-Jehová machigwa-baid anga uksabalid.”
Lea gannar machigwa-baid-nikunonibalid. Adi, Levíʼye onugsanonikid. Ar ade, Lea soged: “An-suiba machimala-walapaagus an bakdanisoggu, ar emigindi, an-sui bur bule an walikaa guoed.”
Lea amba machigwa-baid-nikunonibalid. Adi, Judáʼye onugsasad, ar ade, Lea soged: “Ar emigindi, Bab-Jehová-nug an odummogoed.” A-sorbali, Lea mimmigan-nikued galesad.
